scope: Read-only exact rare-order equivalence at frozen round849 and round850; no solve, checkpoint write, cache write, or continuation.

semantics.mono_order: derived Rust Ord on {len:u8, ids:[u8;12]}; canonical zero padding makes this exactly (len, live ids)
semantics.index: frequency buckets with committed sorted Mono bodies and per-round sorted removal/addition deltas
semantics.new_column_update: increment current u32 frequency once for each non-target nonzero row in each new cache record
semantics.commit: for every touched row remove once from its committed-frequency bucket, add once to its final-frequency bucket, then exact natural merge
semantics.rank_materialization: iterate frequency buckets in numeric order and rows in natural Mono order
semantics.restart: rebuild the in-memory index from the exposed vector cache; no serialized schema changes

promotion_gate.performance: incremental_commit + indexed_flatten is less than full baseline sort; recommend integration only if repeatable speedup is at least 1.5x
promotion_gate.second_stage: after order-only PASS, integrate in a cloned source and require one-round output checkpoint SHA c2ea7cc0... and cache SHA df181c0b... before production promotion
promotion_gate.fallback: on any index invariant, order hash, resource, or performance failure, discard the in-memory index and retain the sealed full owned-tuple sort
